items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: That's in Louis Armstrong's book, incidentally, but Morris used to tell me about that quite a bit too.

ctx.x: And you showed me pictures of Morris Music Shops, of Morris Music School. What was that, this music school?

Well, I went to work for Morris Music School, a shop, house they call it, and manager in charge of the band instrument department, I handled that. And then later on, I organized a school, and that was a big thing around New Orleans for many years. In fact, I had a fella came down from Cleveland, and invited me to come up and spend some time on his yacht. Yeah. Well, it was something that, you see, I had, I had worked on this thing quite a while, about this free instruments, you know what I mean? Free instrument…
And, uh, that's a Karnofsky family.
